raw_evidence_cards.document_title: AliGraph: A Comprehensive Graph Neural Network Platform
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: AliGraph is a comprehensive distributed graph neural network platform providing distributed graph storage, optimized sampling operators, and runtime to support GNN training on large-scale graphs.
overlaps: Distributed GNN training on large-scale graphs
Scaling GNN training for industrial scenarios
differences: AliGraph uses distributed graph storage and sampling operators, not graph summarization
AliGraph does not adopt a leader-worker mode with edge-based graph stream partitioning
AliGraph does not use an attention layer to return training results to a leader node

sources.title: AliGraph: A Comprehensive Graph Neural Network Platform
sources.quote: we present a comprehensive graph neural network system, namely AliGraph, which consists of distributed graph storage, optimized sampling operators and runtime to efficiently support not only existing popular GNNs but also a series of in-house developed ones for different scenarios.

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: AGL: a Scalable System for Industrial-purpose Graph Machine Learning
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: AGL is a scalable, fault-tolerant, integrated system for industrial-purpose graph machine learning that supports fully-functional training and inference for GNNs using message passing and k-hop neighborhood generation.
overlaps: Scalable distributed GNN training on large graphs
Training graph attention networks at scale
differences: AGL uses k-hop neighborhood generation and MapReduce, not graph summarization
AGL does not adopt leader-worker mode with edge-based graph stream partitioning
AGL does not use an attention layer to return training results to a leader node

sources.title: AGL: a Scalable System for Industrial-purpose Graph Machine Learning
sources.quote: we design AGL, a scalable, fault-tolerance and integrated system, with fully-functional training and inference for GNNs. Our system design follows the message passing scheme underlying the computations of GNNs.

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: A two-phase streaming edge partitioning algorithm for large-scale uncertain graphs
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposes TPEP (Two-Phase Edge Partitioning), a streaming edge partitioning algorithm to partition large-scale uncertain graphs, formulated as an optimization problem minimizing replicated vertices and balancing partition load.
overlaps: Edge-based graph stream partitioning algorithm
Partitioning large-scale graphs into subgraphs
Streaming partitioning process for large-scale graphs
differences: TPEP targets uncertain graphs, not general graph data for GNN training
TPEP is designed for distributed analysis of uncertain graphs, not specifically for distributed GNN training
TPEP is a two-phase algorithm focused on minimizing replicated vertices and load balance, not on enabling GNN training

sources.title: A two-phase streaming edge partitioning algorithm for large-scale uncertain graphs
sources.quote: This paper presents a streaming edge partitioning algorithm TPEP (Two-Phase Edge Partitioning) to partition the large-scale uncertain graphs.

sources.title: A two-phase streaming edge partitioning algorithm for large-scale uncertain graphs
sources.quote: TPEP uses a score function to guide the streaming partitioning process
